title: SoK: What Makes Private Learning Unfair?

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and systematizing literature that evaluates group fairness disparities by measuring metrics like Accuracy Parity, Demographic Parity, and Equal Opportunity across demographic groups before and after applying Differential Privacy (DP) algorithms like DP-SGD.

Reviewing empirical studies that measure accuracy disparities on census datasets split by sex, as well as studies evaluating binary gender bias in generative language models using Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) under DP constraints.

Reviewing evidence that DP mechanisms (specifically gradient clipping) disproportionately reduce model utility for elderly patients in medical image classification tasks due to their more complex and irregular data distributions.

Analyzing studies that benchmark DP algorithms on tabular census datasets (e.g., Adult, Dutch, and Folktables) to measure disparate impact and empirical risk parity regarding income and employment status.
